title: Distance Calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates S₂S distance using Pythagorean theorem (5 m).

title: Travel Time Computation
description: Essential: Correctly computes both travel times (t₁=0.8 s, t₂=1 s) using v=5 m/s.

title: Time Difference Answer
description: Essential: States final time difference Δt = t₂ - t₁ = 0.2 s for part (1).

title: Elapsed Vibration Time
description: Important: Correctly computes Δt₁ = t - t₁ and Δt₂ = t - t₂ at t=6 s (5.2 s and 5 s).

title: Phase Determination
description: Important: Determines that both Δt₁ and Δt₂ correspond to integer multiples of periods (6.5T₁, 25T₂), leading to zero displacement from each source.

title: Superposition Application
description: Important: Applies superposition principle to sum individual displacements (0 + 0 = 0 cm) for part (2).

title: Final Displacement Answer
description: Essential: States final displacement magnitude = 0 cm for part (2).

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, cm) throughout calculations.

title: Sign/Phase Confusion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly treats phase as non-integer multiple or misinterprets 'outward' oscillation at t=0.

title: Geometry Error
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect geometry (e.g., assumes S is collinear) leading to wrong S₂S distance.
